name: Uz

identification.note: Scholars propose locations in Edom or the Arabian desert east of Canaan, but the text does not fix a precise location.

related_people.name: Elihu
related_people.role: the young man who rebuked Job and his three friends before the LORD spoke

related_people.name: Jemimah
related_people.role: the eldest of Job's daughters, born after the LORD restored him here

related_people.name: Job
related_people.role: the blameless man of this land who lost everything and was restored twofold

related_people.name: Keren-happuch
related_people.role: the youngest of Job's daughters, born after the LORD restored him here

related_people.name: Keziah
related_people.role: the second of Job's daughters, born after the LORD restored him here

description: The homeland of Job, described as "the greatest of all the men of the east" before his sudden loss of family, wealth, and health became the subject of the book that bears his name (Job 1:1-3). Its location is not certain, though Lamentations 4:21 associates the name loosely with Edom.
